fixes.was: At the hearing county chairman Dillard Craiger asked for a duration commitment and complained that none existed; comptroller Russell Hughes warned about job losses from declining market share; other speakers said GM was promising nothing.
fixes.now: County chairman Dillard Craiger asked for a duration commitment and complained that none existed. At the hearing comptroller Russell Hughes warned about job losses from declining market share, Craiger repeated that GM would not say whether or when it might move, and other speakers said GM was promising nothing.
